haslet.mnemonic: haslet – has kar khaya suar ka meat loaf

hart.ex: A hart bounded across the forest clearing.
hart.mnemonic: hart – 'heart' jaisa lage par ye hai nar hiran

hasp.definition: hinged metal fastening for a door or lid
hasp.ex: She locked the trunk with a padlock through the hasp.
hasp.mnemonic: 'has-p' – box band karne wali clasp jaisi kadi

honorary.definition: given as honour without usual duties
honorary.mnemonic: honorary degree = sirf honour ke liye, bina padhe

host.definition: person who entertains or receives guests
host.mnemonic: host = ghar pe guests ko welcome karne wala

habitually.definition: in a usual or regular manner
habitually.ex: He habitually arrives late to work.
habitually.mnemonic: habitually – habit ke mutabik roz roz karna

hedonistic.ex: He led a hedonistic lifestyle of parties.
hedonistic.mnemonic: hedonistic – hey-donuts khao, sirf maza-maza karo

heavyweight.definition: person or thing of great weight/importance
heavyweight.ex: He is a heavyweight boxing champion.

hegemony.definition: dominance of one group over others
hegemony.ex: The empire held hegemony over the region.
hegemony.mnemonic: hegemony – bada desh chhote pe apna raj chalaye

hypochondriac.definition: person obsessively worried about being ill
hypochondriac.ex: The hypochondriac visited the doctor every week.
hypochondriac.mnemonic: hypochondriac – 'hypo' andar, har waqt bimari ka wehm

herbicide.definition: chemical used to kill unwanted plants
herbicide.ex: Farmers sprayed herbicide to remove the weeds.
herbicide.mnemonic: herb ko cide (kill) kare wo herbicide

hurricane.definition: violent tropical storm with strong winds
hurricane.ex: The hurricane destroyed several coastal towns.

henpecked.definition: dominated or nagged constantly by one's wife
henpecked.ex: The henpecked husband agreed to every demand quietly.
henpecked.mnemonic: henpecked – hen (murgi) peck kare, biwi ke control mein

highbrow.ex: The film was too highbrow for most viewers.
highbrow.mnemonic: high brow – uunchi bhauhen, badi soch wale

hagiographer.definition: writer of saints' lives or idealized biographies
hagiographer.ex: The hagiographer glorified the monk's every deed.
hagiographer.mnemonic: hagio = holy, grapher = likhne wala; sant ki katha likhta hai

horse-power.mnemonic: horse-power – ghode jitni taakat, engine ki power

hallowed.ex: The soldiers were buried on hallowed ground.
hallowed.mnemonic: hallowed – halo waala pavitra jagah, poojneeya

handsy.definition: inappropriately touching others with the hands
handsy.ex: He got too handsy at the party.
handsy.mnemonic: handsy – bar bar haath lagane wala aadmi

heliophile.definition: organism or plant that thrives in sunlight
heliophile.ex: The sunflower is a classic heliophile, always facing the sun.
heliophile.mnemonic: heliophile – helicopter upar dhoop mein udta, sun-lover

hibernate.definition: spend winter in dormant sleeping state
hibernate.ex: Bears hibernate through the cold months.
hibernate.mnemonic: hibernate = hibern (winter) mein bear so jaata hai

hoist.definition: raise or lift something using equipment
hoist.ex: They hoisted the flag at dawn.
hoist.mnemonic: hoist – rassi se jhanda oopar hoist karo

hobble.ex: He hobbled home on his injured foot.

hostels.definition: cheap lodging places for students or travellers
hostels.ex: Many students live in college hostels.
hostels.mnemonic: hostels – 'host' ke ghar jaise saste rehne ki jagah

horrible.definition: causing horror; extremely unpleasant or bad
horrible.mnemonic: horrible = horror film jaisa, dekhke rongte khade

hydra.ex: Corruption is a hydra that keeps returning.
hydra.mnemonic: hydra – 'hydro' water me rehne wala bahu-sir dानव

herpetologist.definition: scientist who studies reptiles and amphibians
herpetologist.ex: The herpetologist caught a rare snake.
herpetologist.mnemonic: herpetologist – 'herpet' saap-jaisa creeping jeev padhne wala

hasitate.definition: spelling mistake; means to pause before doing something
hasitate.ex: Please do not hesitate to ask your teacher for help.

hygene.definition: cleanliness of body (spelling mistake, correct is hygiene)
hygene.ex: This word is written wrong; the right spelling is 'hygiene'.

hiest.ex: Mount Everest is the hiest mountain in the world.

hoisting.definition: raising or lifting up, especially with ropes
hoisting.ex: They were hoisting the flag at dawn.

homonyms.definition: words spelt/sounding alike with different meanings
homonyms.mnemonic: homonyms – 'homo' same naam, alag alag matlab

harrasment.definition: spelling mistake; means same as harassment
harrasment.ex: The word is harassment, not harrasment.

hallucinogenic.ex: LSD is a powerful hallucinogenic drug.
hallucinogenic.mnemonic: hallucination + genic – jo hallucination paida kare

holitisc.ex: Rahul wrote 'holitisc' instead of holistic in his exam.

harange.definition: a long angry speech that bores people
harange.ex: The teacher gave a harangue about late homework submissions.

harassed.ex: She felt harassed by the constant phone calls.
harassed.mnemonic: harassed – 'ha rass' khatam, boss ne pareshan kar diya

habitat.definition: natural home of an animal or plant
habitat.ex: The forest is a habitat for tigers.
habitat.mnemonic: habitat – jahan animal ki aadat (habit) hai rehne ki

hygiene.definition: practices for maintaining health and cleanliness
hygiene.ex: Good hygiene prevents the spread of disease.
hygiene.mnemonic: hygiene – 'high-jean' saaf rakho, safai se sehat

hektic.definition: same as hectic, very busy and rushed
hektic.ex: Monday mornings are hektic in every house.

histrionic.definition: overly theatrical or dramatic in behaviour
histrionic.ex: Her histrionic outburst embarrassed everyone at the meeting.
histrionic.mnemonic: histrionic – hero ka overacting drama, natakbaazi

heal.definition: to become or make healthy again
heal.ex: The wound will heal in a week.
heal.mnemonic: heal – ghaav ko theek karke health wapas

he’ll.mnemonic: he + will = he'll, apostrophe se short

heel.definition: the back part of the human foot
heel.ex: She hurt her heel while running.
heel.mnemonic: heel – high heel sandal edi pe pehna

heard.definition: past tense of hear; perceived sound
heard.ex: I heard a strange noise last night.
